description: This file contains functions and types for managing and parsing Claude CLI session history files, including reading session data, normalizing content, and handling tool call and result messages.

methods.name: resolveClaudeCliSessionFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for a Claude CLI session JSONL file based on session ID and optional home directory.

methods.name: readClaudeCliSessionMessages
methods.description: Reads and parses messages from a Claude CLI session file, returning an array of transcript messages.
